business_scope.primary_industry_name: Computerized Embroidery and Ultrasonic Seaming of Custom Plush Dolls

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified Roman-Germanic tradition; unitary national law; no sub-state distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Articles 49 and 54 (freedom of establishment for EU nationals and companies)
Belgo-Luxembourg Economic Union (BLEU) bilateral investment treaty network - 60+ active treaties, incl. BLEU-China BIT (signed 1984, in force 1986)
Luxembourg double taxation avoidance agreements - 80+ active, incl. United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, China, Hong Kong SAR, UAE
EU-Canada Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA; provisional application since 21 September 2017)
New York Convention 1958 on Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (ratified by Luxembourg, 1983)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), notably Articles 710-1 et seq. (Société à Responsabilité Limitée), Article 710-9 (minimum subscribed capital), and Article 710-12 (payment of cash contributions); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies and the Luxembourg Business Registers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), 2 Avenue John F. Kennedy, L-1855 Luxembourg; electronic filings at rcs.lbr.lu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized deed of incorporation — 'Acte constitutif' (Articles of Association) executed before a Luxembourg notary and filed electronically with the RCS, accompanied by the bank blocking certificate for the share capital and the statutory contributions auditor's report where in-kind contributions are made.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 12,000 (approx. USD 13,100) minimum subscribed capital; capital must be fully subscribed. Cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked Luxembourg bank account in favor of the notary, with at least 25% (EUR 3,000) paid up at incorporation and the balance payable within five years. In-kind contributions must be fully paid up at incorporation and supported by a report of a réviseur d'entreprises (approved statutory auditor), unless waived by unanimous partner resolution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.à r.l. At a meeting of the management and the subscribing partners held on [date], the following resolutions were adopted unanimously: 1. The Articles of Association are adopted and the share capital of EUR 12,000, divided into 12,000 shares of EUR 1.00 each, is fully subscribed and allotted to [Shareholders]; the banker's certificate evidencing blocking of the cash subscriptions is ratified. 2. The registered office of the Company is fixed at [address], Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. 3. [Name] is appointed sole Manager (Gérant) with full powers to manage and represent the Company. 4. The Manager is authorized to open bank accounts, file the deed with the RCS, and effect all tax, social, and regulatory registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and preparation of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS online portal — rcs.lbr.lu) acting through the instructing Luxembourg notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a preliminary name request with the RCS through the preparing notary to obtain a name availability confirmation (absence de confusion). Confirm that the corporate name includes the suffix 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or 'S.à r.l.'. Simultaneously instruct corporate counsel to prepare the draft Articles of Association, the corporate purpose tailored to ISIC 3240 (manufacture of plush mascots, stuffed toys, and embroidered textile products), the share subscription schedule, and the complete anti-money-laundering KYC file.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (three ranked alternatives)
Identity and nationality of each subscribing shareholder
Corporate purpose description aligned with ISIC 3240
Draft Articles of Association
Power of attorney if a representative executes the deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for risk of confusion with an existing RCS registration or a protected distinctive sign, promptly refile with an alternative name; a corrected request submitted within 15 days incurs no additional fee beyond the standard RCS tariff.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of blocked incorporation account and payment of share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (e.g., BIL, BNP Paribas Luxembourg, Société Générale Luxembourg) acting under CSSF anti-money-laundering supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a 'compte de formation' (incorporation account) in the name of the company in formation with the instruction 'bloqué au profit du notaire instrumentant'. Transfer the subscribed cash capital (at least the 25% minimum paid-up portion). The bank delivers a blocking certificate (certificat de blocage) addressed to the notary, confirming the deposit amount, the depositors, and the blocked status; the certificate is annexed to the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copies and proof of address of each shareholder
Source-of-funds evidence (bank statements, dividend credit advices, sale agreements)
Tax residence certificate or tax identification number of each shareholder
Draft Articles of Association
Anti-money-laundering declaration form and ultimate beneficial ownership chart
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank suspends the file for incomplete KYC, remediate by supplying updated source-of-funds documentation and a consolidated ownership chart; funding may alternatively be wired from an EU/EEA regulated credit institution to simplify due diligence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the notarized Articles of Association (Acte constitutif)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg); deed executed at the notary's office in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary convenes the subscribing shareholders or their attorneyed representatives to execute the deed of incorporation in authentic form. The notary verifies legal capacity, legality of the corporate purpose, the bank blocking certificate, and the contributions auditor's report for any in-kind contribution. The deed fixes the registered office, appoints the first manager(s), and evidences the payment of subscription moneys. The notary certifies the deed and prepares the electronic RCS filing package.
required_dossiers: Bank blocking certificate from the incorporation account
Identification documents of shareholders and appointed managers
Réviseur d'entreprises report on in-kind contributions (if any)
Name clearance confirmation from the RCS
Original powers of attorney for persons executing by representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues an adjournment for a legal defect in the draft deed, amend and re-execute the deed without a new filing tariff; scrivener's errors in the deed may be corrected by a notarial rectification rider (acte rectificatif) within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the RCS and acquisition of legal personality
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) of Luxembourg, registered in the Luxembourg Business Registers system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary files the incorporation deed electronically within five days of execution, together with the Form 1 (demande d'inscription) identifying the company, managers, registered office, and corporate purpose, and the beneficial-owner declaration. The RCS registry officer examines conformity and issues the RCS number (format L-XXXXXX) and the certificate of legal personality (extrait du RCS). Legal personality takes effect only upon this registration, not upon notarization.
required_dossiers: Notarized Acte constitutif
Bank blocking certificate (if not fully transcribed in the deed)
RCS Form 1 application for registration
Beneficial-owner declaration to the RCS register of beneficial owners
Written consent and specimen signature of each appointed manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query (demande de complément), the notary submits the missing data within 15 days; substantive errors in the deed require a rectification deed, while purely formal omissions (postal address, signature specimen) can be cured by letter submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the RESA and application for the business establishment permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations) published by LBR; Direction de l'autorisation d'établissement of the Ministère de l'Économie
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following RCS registration, the deed and notarial appointment statements are published in the RESA electronic journal within one month. The manager then applies for the autorisation d'établissement under the Law of 28 December 2023 on access to professions, declaring the activity 'manufacture of toys, plush dolls, and embroidered textile articles (ISIC 3240)', and submitting the manager's criminal record, professional qualification evidence, occupation of the production premises, and a description of the machinery to be installed.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract
Manager's criminal records (Luxembourg casier judiciaire and country-of-origin equivalent)
Diplomas or attestation of at least three years' professional experience in manufacturing/trade
Lease contract or title deed for the production facility
Site plan showing embroidery, cutting, ultrasonic seaming, and packaging areas
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the license is refused for insufficient professional qualification, file a qualification equivalence dossier with the Commission des qualifications professionnelles; a negative decision may be appealed to the Tribunal administratif within three months, and operations may commence only upon issuance of the permit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, social security, and environmental classed-establishment registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Administration des contributions directes (ACD); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS); Administration de l'environnement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The manager files the registration for corporate income tax, municipal business tax, and VAT using form 1904-CIR with the AEDT and obtains a VAT number. If employees are hired, the employer registers with the CCSS. Concurrently, submit the 'établissement classé' dossier for the plush manufacturing workshop under the amended Law of 10 June 1999, providing machinery inventory, material flows, noise/vibration data, waste streams, and fire-safety measures for the computerized embroidery and ultrasonic seaming lines.
required_dossiers: RCS incorporation extract and articles of association
Business establishment permit (autorisation d'établissement)
VAT registration form 1904-CIR and identity of the tax representative
CCSS employer registration form (if employing personnel)
Machinery layout and emissions/waste data for environmental classification
Document unique de sécurité (workplace safety and health plan)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental classification is raised from declaration to full authorization, submit the missing technical annexes (noise map, waste inventory, fire-load calculations) within the 30-day administrative cure period; provisional operation is permissible where an explicit authorization request has been timely filed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie — Direction de l'autorisation d'établissement (business establishment permit); Administration de l'environnement, Ministère de l'Environnement, du Climat et de la Biodiversité (classed-establishment environmental permit); Inspection du Travail et des Mines (occupational safety clearance)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (business establishment permit for toy and plush manufacturing under the Law of 28 December 2023 on access to professions) and Autorisation d'exploitation or notification d'exploitation d'un établissement classé under the amended Law of 10 June 1999 on classified establishments.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement — Ministère de l'Environnement, du Climat et de la Biodiversité
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 'Établissement classé' — Class 2 or Class 3 (simplified authorization or notification) for a plush toy assembly plant using computerized embroidery, ultrasonic seaming, and low-VOC adhesives. Full EIA report not triggered: the activity is not listed in Annexes I–II of the Law of 15 May 2018 on environmental impact assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: Grand-Ducal Regulation of 16 May 2000 on discharge into public sewers — pH 6.5–9.5, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 300 mg/L, total suspended solids ≤ 100 mg/L, and no priority hazardous substances. VOC: solvent consumption from cleaning agents and adhesives below 2 t/yr maintains the installation outside the solvent-management plan obligation; all fugitive emissions must comply with the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 3 June 2004, with an odour nuisance perimeter of 50 m from the workshop boundary. Waste: mandatory producer registration and documented disposal through an authorized collector for non-hazardous polyester fiber trimmings and cardboard packaging under the Law of 21 March 2017 on waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: prior approval of the competent communal fire-prevention service (Service de prévention et d'extinction d'incendie) based on a fire-safety report covering fire-resistance classes of materials, emergency egress width, and extinguisher coverage. Structural load: signed attestation by a civil engineer validating floor-load capacity for embroidery machines, compacted storage racks, and ultrasonic equipment. Occupational: workplace clearance by the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM), confirming CE-marking of all embroidery and ultrasonic machines under the Law of 4 December 1974 on dangerous machinery, noise exposure not exceeding 87 dB(A) peak, dust control below 10 mg/m³ occupational exposure limit for textile fibers, and a compliant Document Unique de Sécurité.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Luxembourg Registration Duties, Estates and VAT Authority (Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA – AEDT) for VAT; Luxembourg Direct Tax Authority (Administration des contributions directes – ACD) for corporate income tax; unified public portal: MyGuichet.lu (myguichet.lu)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For an LU SARL, incorporation is effected by notarial deed and registered with the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR). Upon registration, the entity automatically receives a 13-digit national identification number (matricule) and is registered with the ACD for direct tax purposes. VAT registration with the AEDT is mandatory if the annual taxable turnover exceeds EUR 35,000, if intra-Community acquisitions or distance sales are conducted, or if the entity engages in import/export activities; registration is also available on an optional basis to recover input VAT. Foreign entities establishing a branch or permanent establishment follow the same registration steps and may be required to appoint a local VAT agent or direct-tax representative. The resulting VAT ID takes the format LU followed by an eight-digit identifier.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Election to constitute a fiscal unity (intégration fiscale) under Article 164bis of the Luxembourg Income Tax Law (LIR); option to form a VAT grouping as a single taxable person under Article 60 of the Luxembourg VAT Law; waiver of the small-enterprise VAT exemption to apply standard VAT rules; application of the participation exemption regime for qualifying dividend and capital-gain income; and hybrid mismatch adjustments pursuant to the EU Anti-Tax-Avoidance Directive (ATAD) provisions as enacted in the LIR.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA – Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée), harmonised EU VAT regime
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for established small businesses under Article 7a of the Luxembourg VAT Law; no threshold applies to non-established foreign suppliers or to businesses engaged in intra-Community acquisitions, import operations, or export operations requiring VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not operate a real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or mandatory digital stamping regime for domestic B2B transactions. Electronic invoicing in standard formats is accepted for B2B purposes, and e-invoicing is mandatory for B2G contracts via the PEPPOL network. VAT returns, periodic recapitulative statements (EC Sales Lists), and Intrastat declarations are filed electronically through MyGuichet.lu and the AEDT online systems, with a statutory retention period of six years for all invoicing and export records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Supplies of goods exported to non-EU destinations qualify for the 0% VAT rate where the goods are physically dispatched from Luxembourg within 90 days of the supply and the supplier holds and preserves conclusive export evidence. Intra-Community supplies of goods to EU business customers are also zero-rated where the customer supplies a valid EU VAT identification number, the goods are transported to another EU member state, and the transaction is correctly reported in the EC Sales List. Certain offshore B2B services (including services related to tangible goods exported outside the EU) are zero-rated based on place-of-supply rules under Article 14 of the Luxembourg VAT Law.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading / CMR / Air Waybill
Proof of export issued by the customs system (SAD export document)
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank SWIFT payment evidence
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT may retroactively reassess VAT and claw back the zero rate where export documentation is absent, incomplete, false, or unsubstantiated. Unsupported zero-rated export declarations are treated as domestic taxable supplies, triggering additional VAT, interest at 0.6% per month, fines ranging from 10% to 200% of the tax due in cases of intentional misdeclaration, and possible criminal sanctions for tax fraud under Article 109 of the Luxembourg General Tax Law. Exporters must retain all proof of export and payment evidence for at least six years. Failure to document FX repatriation within the 180-day benchmark may, in substance-over-form review, lead to denial of the zero-rating benefit and imposition of clawback liabilities together with reputational and audit escalation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), acting together with the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) as the competent central banking, banking supervision, and anti-money laundering supervisory authority in Luxembourg.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is the domestic currency. Luxembourg applies the EU free movement of capital regime under Article 63 TFEU, providing full current-account and capital-account convertibility without central bank exchange-control approval. Profit remittance from the SARL is unrestricted from a foreign-exchange perspective and is subject only to standard corporate law distribution formalities, tax compliance, and any treaty-based or domestic withholding tax on dividends.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion rules apply in Luxembourg or the euro area. Export proceeds may be retained indefinitely in euros or any foreign currency. Resident exporters are only subject to statistical balance-of-payments reporting obligations to the BCL for external transactions, and these do not create conversion or repatriation requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE / Spuerkeess)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for ancillary collections of platform payouts and low-value receivables; Low for use as the SARL's primary treasury, trade settlement, or capital escrow rail. Legal constraints: EU/EEA electronic money institutions and payment institutions may passport into Luxembourg subject to CSSF notification and AML supervision, but they are not credit institutions and cannot hold commercial deposits, issue documentary letters of credit, or access central bank liquidity. Offshore and non-EEA digital EMIs have no passporting rights into Luxembourg and face significant correspondent-banking restrictions, making them unsuitable for the long-term cross-border treasury needs of a manufacturing SARL.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical onboarding interview is generally mandatory for at least one managing director or ultimate beneficial owner at traditional Luxembourg banks, especially where non-EU shareholders are involved. Remote video identification may be permitted only for low-risk EU-resident signatories under applicable AML rules, but a newly incorporated SARL structuring a cross-border plush-toy OEM business should expect an in-person or notarised KYC onboarding process rather than fully remote account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly established SARL with a single non-EU shareholder receiving an immediate capital injection in the first 30 days.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised articles of association; RCS commercial register extract; UBO declaration and RBE extract; shareholder passport and proof of address; source-of-funds documentation for contributed capital (bank statements, audited financial statements, tax certificates); board resolution authorising the capital contribution; written fund-flow narrative explaining the specific injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High concentration of platform-based receivables inconsistent with a physical manufacturing and trade model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan for plush mascot OEM operations; executed OEM and distribution agreements; purchase orders and supplier invoices; platform settlement and reconciliation statements; customs declarations and logistics documentation; product catalogues and certificates of origin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Managing director or UBO has no verifiable industrial track record or Luxembourg economic nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Directors' CVs and professional references; source-of-wealth evidence such as salary slips, investment statements, property records, and inheritance or gift documentation; existing employment contracts; trade reference letters; local substance evidence including lease agreements, administrative support arrangements, and board-meeting minutes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound payments to suppliers in jurisdictions associated with trade-based money-laundering or sanctions vulnerabilities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and politically exposed persons screening results; completed counterparty compliance questionnaires; underlying supply contracts, pro-forma invoices, bills of lading and airway bills; third-party quality inspection certificates; customs entry evidence; a signed anti-circumvention and beneficial-ownership representation from the supplier.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For euro-denominated shareholder capital contributions, use a TARGET2 or SEPA Credit Transfer (ISO 20022 pain.001) with the remittance reference reflecting the corporate purpose and the SARL's registration number. For non-euro injections, use a SWIFT MT103 wire with the applicable BCL balance-of-payments purpose code for direct investment and full bank routing data. Verification by the receiving Luxembourg bank will require the updated RCS extract, UBO declaration, notarised capital-contribution deed, shareholder resolution, and source-of-funds documentation before crediting the capital account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For standard supplier payments, use SWIFT MT103 or MT202 with full beneficiary bank routing, remittance details, and the underlying purchase-order reference. For high-value or risk-sensitive trade settlements, use an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit issued via SWIFT MT700/MT710 with the Luxembourg bank as advising or confirming bank. EU and EEA disbursements can be settled via SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer; payments to Asian and Chinese counterparties should use MT103 or Letter of Credit rails with documents compliant with the applicable cross-border clearing and sanctions-screening requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards with a duly authorised Luxembourg or EU credit institution under ISDA documentation
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on currencies without efficient onshore deliverable forward markets or subject to regulatory access restrictions
Cross-currency swaps under standard ISDA/CSA arrangements
FX options and collars for protecting gross margins on trade receivables and payables
FX swaps for short-term liquidity repositioning between EUR, USD, and CNY

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual RCS data confirmation (Confirmation annuelle des données au Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) / RCS via eJustice portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 December of each calendar year for entities registered in Luxembourg
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Reminder procedure, possible administrative fine, and persistent non-confirmation may lead to administrative strike-off or deregistration of the entity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts filing (Dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of the end of the financial year (e.g., by 31 July for a calendar-year SARL)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties up to EUR 5,000 and judicial astreinte of up to EUR 250 per day; continued default may trigger compulsory dissolution or strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate tax return (CIT / municipal business tax / net wealth tax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally due no later than 30 November of the calendar year following the taxable year unless an extension is granted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing and late-payment interest under Luxembourg tax law, penalties up to EUR 5,000, and criminal fines for deliberate non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO confirmation (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year and within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fines and imprisonment under the Law of 13 January 2019; administrative sanctions and publication of persistent defaults.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit required for an SARL if at least two of three thresholds are exceeded for two consecutive financial years: total balance sheet > EUR 4,400,000; net turnover > EUR 8,800,000; average number of employees > 50. Mandatory audit also applies to certain public-interest entities and consolidating parents.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Law of 19 December 2002 on the annual accounts of undertakings; IFRS as adopted by the EU permitted for consolidated financial statements and optionally for separate annual accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Luxembourg SARL must keep an up-to-date beneficial owner file with the RBE. The entity is required to confirm annually, and at least once each calendar year, that the registered UBO data remain accurate. Any share transfer resulting in a change of beneficial ownership exceeding the 25% threshold must be filed within 30 days. The annual RCS confirmation additionally validates registered corporate details and officers.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 16.00% (2024 reformed IRC base rate); plus 7% solidarity surcharge on the IRC (1.12%) and municipal business tax (ICC) at 6.75% (Luxembourg City), producing an aggregate headline rate of approx. 23.87%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP royalty box (80% exemption of qualifying net IP income – effective ~5.2%), 100% participation exemption on qualifying dividends and capital gains, notional interest deduction (limited), tax losses carried forward without statutory expiry (no carryback), group relief for integrated taxation in certain circumstances
